dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at Clark Parade Grounds, this international marathon brings RunRio's production to the historic former Clark Air Base grounds, with distances from 5K to the full 42.195K.
verdict: The Singlife ONE Clark International Marathon adds another RunRio-organised stop to the Clark Freeport Zone's growing race calendar, held at Clark Parade Grounds -- a historic open space within the former Clark Air Base complex, now used regularly for large events. Four distances from 5K to the full marathon give it standard broad accessibility, and registration is already open. The venue itself has real credibility: it's hosted multiple other races covered in this research batch (the Pampanga Marathon, among others), suggesting genuine operational experience with marathon-scale logistics at this specific site.

sections.heading: Clark Parade Grounds: A Historic, Repeat-Use Venue
paragraphs: Clark Parade Grounds sits within the former Clark Air Base complex, now part of the redeveloped Clark Freeport and Special Economic Zone in Central Luzon. [2] This is the same venue used by the Pampanga Marathon, which has run annually since at least 2022 -- so whatever operator is on site has real, tested experience managing large-field road races at this specific location, even though the Singlife ONE Clark event itself is organised separately.
